messages:
Irene: quick heads-up — we need project-scoped API keys for a customer migration. Goal: let teams rotate project keys independently from org keys and have clear quota attribution. cc @Kevin @Marta :eyes:
Kevin: do you mean per-key quota buckets or mapping keys -> project -> org quota? implications for rate limiting and billing.
Marta: prefer mapping keys -> project -> quota_bucket. keeps billing/accounting simple. UI would show a key's effective quota and a link to the project. fallback to org-level if no project bound.
Darren: watch out for impersonation flow: service accounts creating short-lived tokens will need provenance so we don't lose audit trails. audit logs must show original service account and claimed project.
Kevin: routing-wise, token affinity matters for KV cache locality. If we bind keys to projects, router should prefer the tenant-pinned pool to get cache hits. fallback policy: if pool full, route to any compatible pool and tag request with "routing_decision" for later analysis.
Marta: quick API sketch (proto/JSON):
```json
{
  "key_id": "k_abc",
  "scope": "project",
  "project_id": "proj_123",
  "quota_bucket": "proj_123_tokens",
  "created_by": "service_account:sa-rotate"
}
```
Marta: console UX: when creating a key show a dropdown: [Org key | Project key (select project)]. Add small helper text: "Project keys limit rotation blast radius — recommended for app-level credentials."
Irene: telemetry we should emit on each request: `token_source` (org|project|ephemeral), `project_id`, `org_id`, `key_id`, `effective_quota_bucket`, `routing_pool`, and `cache_hit` boolean. Also emit a `token_binding_change` event when a key is re-bound.
Kevin: agree. add sampled stacktrace/tracing headers for cost attribution flows: `x-rw-trace` and `x-rw-sample`. We can tag heavy callers.
Darren: must ensure audit retention for token binding changes is kept longer than 90d for enterprise customers. also exportable to S3/kms.
deploy-bot: auth-service v2.1.0 deployed to canary (5%) — includes token scope field and routing_decision header.
Marta: rollout plan suggestion: 1) API + runtime support behind feature flag, 2) console UX hidden toggle, 3) enable telemetry sampling, 4) open opt-in for a few customers, 5) ramp. Need owner for RFC + canary dashboard.
Irene: I'll draft RFC today and add a lightweight canary dashboard in Grafana for `routing_decision` and `quota_bucket` cardinality.
Kevin: I'll follow up on router changes and KV cache affinity.
Darren: I'll draft audit/export config and check retention.
Marta: ping me for console PR review. :thumbsup:
Irene: action items: (I) RFC w/ API schema (me), (II) router affinity changes (Kevin), (III) console dropdown + helptext (Marta), (IV) audit/retention (Darren). Meeting if needed.
Kevin: SGTM.
Marta: SGTM.
Darren: SGTM.
Irene: thanks — marking as RFC WIP.
